tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Crimson Deep (Figma). The action colour: primary buttons, active tab, selected and checked states, key brand moments. One primary action per screen. Never use Signal Red (accent) for actions: in money products bright red reads as an error. In dark it flips to Chalk with Crimson text, as Figma does for buttons on Crimson sections.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind brand content: selected rows, highlighted chips, onboarding panels. Light value is Figma's secondary-button background (Crimson at 10% on white).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills (13.2:1 light, 11.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal Red (Figma). Only the logo and a highlighted phrase in headlines 24px and larger, plus small decorative icons. FLAG: 3.75:1 on white and 3.35:1 on Chalk, so it fails 4.5:1 and must never be body text, links, buttons or status. 4.99:1 on Obsidian in dark.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The deep identity colour. Card faces, hero panels, SaaS sidebar. Obsidian (Figma).

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on night surfaces.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Secondary highlight tint for illustrations, empty states and marketing accents. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default app background (mobile) and content panels (SaaS).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: SaaS page canvas behind cards; grouped list backgrounds on mobile. Chalk (Figma).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus and dialogs. Pair with a shadow token in light, with line in dark.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Fill of text fields, selects and date triggers (Figma Input field: Chalk). Always with a line-strong border, because the fill alone is 1.1:1 against white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on any surface. Obsidian in light, Chalk in dark (Figma Text/primary).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and surface-sunken. 80% Obsidian / 80% Chalk (Figma Text/secondary).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Exempt from contrast; never use for information.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only. Warm grey used for dividers in the Figma page designs.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 against surface). Figma's own checkbox border (#EBEBEB, 1.2:1) and input edge (Chalk, 1.1:1) fail this, so components use line-strong instead.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive element. Blue so it never reads as an error on red brand fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Money in, completed payments, verified states. Text-safe on surface. Light value is Figma's 'Live' green.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and alerts. Light value from Figma's 'Live' chip.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending, expiring, needs attention. Text-safe on surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, declined, destructive. A bright alert red, deliberately distinct from the Crimson brand (2.4:1 apart) and always paired with an icon or word so it is never confused with brand.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for danger badges and alerts.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system information and links inside alerts.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series, always: your own business or the metric the chart is about. Crimson Deep in light, Chalk in dark, so no series reads as an error. Assign chart-1→4 in fixed order; never cycle or reuse for status.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (comparison period, second channel).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series. A fifth series folds into 'Other' or small multiples. The four are validated for colour-blind separation in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the baseline: recessive, decorative only.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", Arial, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Website and marketing hero headlines (Figma H1).
styles.sample: The infrastructure behind how money moves

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Marketing heroes and SaaS empty-state headlines. Figma H2.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding screens and dashboard page titles on desktop. Figma H3.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Screen title (mobile), page title (SaaS). Figma H4.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headers, sheet titles. Figma H5.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles. Figma Text xl.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Default body on mobile (matches iOS/Android reading size). Figma Text lg.
styles.sample: Your transfer is on its way and should arrive within minutes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body in SaaS, secondary body on mobile. Figma Text md.
styles.sample: Settlements are processed every business day at 18:00.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense tables, helper text, metadata. Figma Text sm.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, tabs. Figma Text sm medium.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, tab-bar labels, chart axes. Figma Text xs.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: Account balance hero. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in lists and tables, right-aligned, tabular.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IDs, API keys, references, card BIN/last-4 in SaaS.

spacing.note: A 4px base grid. Mobile screens use space-4 (16) side gutters; SaaS content uses space-6 (24) to space-8 (32).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related elements: label and field, icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips, list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile screen gutter, card padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (md/lg).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: SaaS card padding and gutters, gap between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: SaaS page top padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Major vertical rhythm on marketing and empty states.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tiny tags, table cell highlights.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs in dense SaaS tables, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, list groups, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, payment cards, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatars, switches, segmented tabs.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and list groups.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the mobile tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

size.note: Control heights. Anything tappable on mobile is at least size-control-lg (48) or has a 44px hit area.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense SaaS toolbars and table actions only. Never on mobile.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default SaaS buttons and fields. 44px matches Figma's buttons and Input field (10px padding + 24px line).

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Default mobile buttons and fields.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Standard icon box (20px glyph on a 24px grid, 1.75px stroke).

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar height, excluding the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones in landscape; single column ends.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets; mobile tab bar becomes a side rail.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: SaaS layout with fixed sidebar.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Max content width for SaaS dashboards.

motion.note: Motion is quick and functional. Components use only these tokens (no raw ms or cubic-bezier values). With prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 0ms, so nothing moves.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.use: Something moving or changing on screen

tokens.name: motion-distance
tokens.use: How far menus, toasts and panels travel as they appear
